# Baiden Creatives

> Baiden Creatives is a creative and technology company in Accra, Ghana, founded by Baiden David and Baiden Daniel. It designs, builds and runs five products of its own: Blueprint, SiteMart, BAID X, PropertIQ and Skin Lab. Statement: "Built from imagination. Made for impact."

Founders: Baiden David and Baiden Daniel (co-founders).
Website: https://www.baidencreatives.org/
Email: edstudios77@gmail.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +233 55 836 2423
Social: @baidencreatives on TikTok (https://www.tiktok.com/@baidencreatives), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/baidencreatives), X (https://x.com/baidencreatives) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/baidencreatives).
Based in: Accra, Ghana. Language: English.

## Products
- Blueprint: a marketplace where architects and designers in Ghana sell ready-made house plans, and homeowners and developers find, compare and buy them, or ask the architect to adjust one. Status: coming soon.
- SiteMart: a marketplace for construction equipment to rent or buy (excavators, trucks, mixers, tools) and building materials (cement, blocks, sand, iron rods, tiles, roofing), paid safely and delivered to site. Status: coming soon.
- BAID X: Ghana's work network. Verified workers, companies, project managers, suppliers and clients across all 16 regions; job payments are held in escrow until the client approves the work. Live: https://www.baid-x.com
- PropertIQ: homes, apartments, offices and stores in Accra, with prices, payment plans, floor plans, brochures and a live map, listed by developers and agents. Status: launching soon.
- Skin Lab: a laptop sticker and skin shop in Accra, with a 3D laptop designer and mobile money checkout. Live: https://shop.baidencreatives.org

## How the products connect
Blueprint, SiteMart, BAID X and PropertIQ form one building and property ecosystem:
1. Plan, with Blueprint: get the house plan from architects in Ghana.
2. Supply, with SiteMart: buy the materials and rent the equipment.
3. Build, with BAID X: hire verified workers and run the project.
4. Sell, with PropertIQ: list and sell the finished property.
One promise across all four: verified people, safe payments and everything needed to build, in one place. Skin Lab is a separate consumer product.

## What Baiden Creatives does
Web design and development, mobile apps and digital products, branding and visual identity, graphic design and campaigns, UI/UX and dashboards, creative technology.
